title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.4
subtitle: A cleaner Quick Assign and reliable object-local Pinning feedback.

highlights.title: New Look by default
highlights.description: New installations start with the floating viewport controls enabled. The preference remains available if you want to return to the classic presentation.

highlights.title: Compact Quick Assign
highlights.description: Quick Assign now labels Soft Body as SBD, Collider as COLL and Cable / Rope as CABLE. The normal Physics UI keeps its full descriptive role names.

highlights.title: Object-local Pinning feedback
highlights.description: An empty Pin Group on one deformable no longer mirrors its validation error onto another object with valid pinned vertices. Cloth and Soft Body also use the clearer Shrink panel name.
